crossRefs.note: Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral…
nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.
Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that…
But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;
Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and…
envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that…
Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil…
For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have…
Charge those who are rich in this present world that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty…
But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all…
Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.
translations.bsb: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater) has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
translations.kjv: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
translations.asv: For this ye know of a surety, that no fornicator, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and God.
